cards.name: Board Side Castle
cards.text: Switch the positions of your {King} and one of your {Rook}s. Then, pass the turn.

cards.name: Running King
cards.text: If you move your {King} this turn, it moves two squares instead of one. This card cannot be used to capture a piece.

cards.name: Teleport
cards.text: Switch the positions of your {King} and another piece. Then, pass the turn.

cards.name: Rush
cards.text: If you move a {Pawn} this turn, it moves two squares instead of one. This card cannot be used to capture a piece.

cards.name: Stealth
cards.text: Move one of your pieces to any empty square without resulting in a check or checkmate. Then, pass the turn.

cards.name: Isolate
cards.text: Choose an opponent's piece. It cannot move on their next turn.

cards.name: Aura
cards.text: Choose an empty square. Pieces cannot move to or over that square until the start of your next turn.

cards.name: Reroute
cards.text: Change the file of one of your {Pawn}s.

cards.name: Formation
cards.text: If you move a {Pawn}, you may move all {Pawn}s in that {Pawn} island in the same way.

cards.name: Hello Neighbor
cards.text: Your {Pawn}s can move diagonally this turn.

cards.name: Retreat
cards.text: Your {Pawn}s can move backwards this turn.

cards.name: Fortress
cards.text: Choose a piece. That piece cannot be captured by your opponent on their next turn.

cards.name: Symmetry
cards.text: Remove two identical pieces of different colors from the board.

cards.name: Safety Measures
cards.text: Your opponent cannot put your {King} in check on their next turn.

cards.name: Compelled
cards.text: Your opponent must capture a piece on their next turn.

cards.name: Risk
cards.text: Ignore a check. You cannot put your opponent's {King} in check, and your opponent cannot capture your {King} on their next turn.

cards.name: Smart
cards.text: Your {Pawn}s can capture in any direction this turn.

cards.name: Battle Ram
cards.text: Your {Pawn}s can capture forward this turn.

cards.name: Invade
cards.text: Your {Pawn}s can capture horizontally this turn.

cards.name: Bodyguard
cards.text: Place a captured {Pawn} on an empty square adjacent to your {King}. Then, pass the turn.

cards.name: Promotion
cards.text: If you do not have a {Queen} on the board, replace one of your {Pawn}s with a {Queen}. Then, pass the turn.

cards.name: Displaced
cards.text: Remove a piece from the board, then return it to the board on the same square at the end of your turn.

cards.name: Kingified
cards.text: Your {Pawn}s can move like a {King} this turn.

cards.name: Pawnified
cards.text: Your pieces can move like a {Pawn} this turn.

cards.name: Knightified
cards.text: Your {Pawn}s can move like a {Knight} this turn.

cards.name: Bishopified
cards.text: Your {Pawn}s can move like a {Bishop} this turn.

cards.name: Rookified
cards.text: Your {Pawn}s can move like a {Rook} this turn.

cards.name: Queenified
cards.text: Your {Pawn}s can move like a {Queen} this turn.

cards.name: Exchange
cards.text: Remove one of your pieces from the board, then place a captured piece of equal or lesser value on that square. You gain points equal to the difference in their values.

cards.name: Backup
cards.text: Place a captured {Pawn} on an empty square on your second rank.

cards.name: Mimic
cards.text: When you capture a piece, you may transform your capturing piece into the type of piece that was captured.

cards.name: Balance
cards.text: Your opponent may place 1 captured {Pawn} on their second rank. Then, you may do the same.

cards.name: Plan B
cards.text: Your opponent must change their last move to a different legal move.

cards.name: Insight
cards.text: Look at your opponent’s hand.

cards.name: Take Priority
cards.text: If this card is in your opening hand and you have the black pieces, you start the game.

cards.name: Revisit
cards.text: Return any card from the discard pile to your hand.

cards.name: Deny
cards.text: Nullify the effects of a target card. You cannot play cards on your next turn.

cards.name: Tactics
cards.text: Gain 2 points.

cards.name: Armageddon
cards.text: If you have no pieces on the board except your {King}, you win the game.

cards.name: Suspend
cards.text: Skip this turn. After your next turn, take an extra turn.
